front view of a narrow sharpened log palisade post with a red war banner
top-down view of a uniform seamless tileable texture of rough logs laid side by side, no objects, no border, filling the whole picture
a stack of sandbags, dark fantasy pixel art dungeon prop
a cluster of sharpened wooden stakes, dark fantasy pixel art dungeon prop
